[[Decade Daggers "High Noon"]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] obtained from [[Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith]] in [[Embark Beach]] during the [[Anniversary Celebration]] in exchange for 5 [[Proof of Legend|Proofs of Legend]]. 

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage|Slashing Dmg]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:Deals 20% additional [[damage]] during [[Special event|Festival events]]. No effect in [[PvP]].
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:Energy regeneration -1
:[[Health]] +30
:Crafted in tribute to an enduring legend.

==Skin==
This item has the same appearance as two [[Fiery Gladius]]es [[dye]]d black. Normally the Fiery Gladius is exclusively available as a [[sword]].

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as the "+20% damage during Festival Events" mod does not exist outside the unique Decade weapons.

==Notes==
*The inherent bonus damage during events is only active during certain events ([[Canthan New Year]], [[Anniversary Celebration]], [[Dragon Festival]], [[Wayfarer's Reverie]], [[Halloween]], and [[Wintersday]]).
{{anomaly|Unlike [[Decade Rod "All the World"]], [[Decade Rod "Antipode Alloy"]], [[Decade Rod "Undying Service"]], [[Decade Staff "Astral Pillar"]], [[Decade Staff "Underworld Pillar"]] and all non-Decade [[weapon]]s, this daggers' appearance is not changed when the wielder is under the effects of a [[weapon spell]].}}

==Trivia==
*Introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20150422|April 22, 2015 update]].
